# pixel-diet

Numbers-first evaluation for computer vision: image diffs, segmentation masks, depth maps, contact sheets.

## Links

- Repository: https://github.com/slowpoke-flex/pixel-diet
- Skill: ./SKILL.md
- Quickstart: ./README.md
- Chinese: ./README.zh-CN.md
- Russian: ./README.ru.md
- Topics: ./docs/github-topics.md
- Launch: ./LAUNCH.md

## Use

Run `pixel-diet diff A B --brief --json report.json --sheet sheet.png` before opening an image.
Read the JSON, open only the named regions, report n / slice / metric / threshold.
